summary: An interactive website that identifies and compares Earth locations similar to the Moon and Mars. A website with interactive maps , planetary location selection, analog site rankings , and environmental data. Helps the users to discover Earth locations that can support lunar and Martian research and mission preparation. Support space research, astronaut training, and future Moon and Mars.
details:
1. Terra Analog Atlas is an interactive website that identifies and compares Earth locations similar to the environments of the Moon and Mars.

2. It helps researchers and space enthusiasts discover Earth locations that can support space research and astronaut training.

3. HTML ,CSS , JavaScript ,Interactive maps ,and web technologies are used.

4.It creatively connects Earth geography with planetary exploration through interactive maps location rankings, and environmental compressions.

5.Environmental similarities, terrain, climate, usability, accessibility of information, and the usefulness of locations for space exploration.
